summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers and env var names to hinny.shop
details: On `npm install`, postinstall.js collects os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.userInfo().username, cwd, the full list of process.env keys, and a timestamp, and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://www.hinny.shop/api. The package ships no real functionality (index.js is empty) and the version (9999.0.0) and scoped name are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal @zmtcdn scope. The beacon runs automatically and unconditionally at install time against a non-publisher domain, giving the operator of hinny.shop reconnaissance data on every installer that resolves this package.
